With Friends Like These Hemp Doesn’t Need Any Enemies

(Marijuananews note: Last week I got the following from cair@cair.net  [Sam H. Clauder II]:

To Cowan@marijuananews.com

"Where's the story about the California Democratic Party adopting the resolution?"

To which I responded: See Marijuana Induces Minimum Driving Impairment Compared to Alcohol; California Democrats Adopt Resolution Supporting Hemp—NORML Weekly Press Release
athttp://www.marijuananews.com/marijuana_induces_minimum_drivin.htm

(Marijuananews note: Last week I got the following from cair@cair.net  [Sam H. Clauder II]:

To Cowan@marijuananews.com

"Where's the story about the California Democratic Party adopting the resolution?"

To Cowan@marijuananews.com

"Where's the story about the California Democratic Party adopting the resolution?"

To which I responded: See Marijuana Induces Minimum Driving Impairment Compared to Alcohol; California Democrats Adopt Resolution Supporting Hemp—NORML Weekly Press Release
athttp://www.marijuananews.com/marijuana_induces_minimum_drivin.htm

I received the following response:

5/1/99 2:31:13 PM Central Daylight Time cair@cair.net (Sam H. Clauder II)

To cowan@marijuananews.com

Neither Allen St. Pierre nor the NORML Foundation asked or told me that they were going to release a PR about this. They had no authority to do this. Please explain why, with all the other PR’s that were sent out about this campaign, that the only one you posted was from an organization that has never shown any interest in propagating the truth about Industrial Hemp? Is this website sponsored by NORML?

Since the DEA and ONDCP stopped arguing against Industrial Hemp years ago, marijuana smokers are the only ones left to oppose CAIR’s campaign. No media outlet in California can get any individual or entity, public or private, to argue against me on the issues surrounding Industrial Hemp.
See

My concern with your website and the posting of this PR is that, by citing me and NORML as sources of the story, you’re feeding naive minds the same false propaganda that the DEA and ONDCP used to promulgate— the bald-faced lie that Industrial Hemp and mj are the same thing. And, in the face of the complete retreat of the DEA and ONDCP to continue this falsehood, you are all that’s left.

I challenge you to acknowledge and accept what has been indisputably proven to me over and over again, that Industrial Hemp is not mj, in any way, shape and form, once the seed is planted in the ground. But I especially want your cooperation in ceasing to discredit this and other campaigns on behalf of Industrial Hemp by reporting on them as if they are furthering the cause of mj legalization.
See

If not, then please pull this PR off your website and don’t post another report on this campaign. But, especially, DON’T EVER MENTION ME, C.A.I.R., OR OUR CAMPAIGN ON BEHALF OF INDUSTRIAL HEMP, IN THE SAME CONTEXT WITH ANY (ab)NORML CHAPTER OR PERSON, AGAIN!!!!!

Thank you.

(Marijuananews note: First, when a press release goes out it is not customary to call the sender to ask for permission to quote it. After all, that is why releases are sent out. And you can quote me on that.

Second, if it weren’t for Jack Herer most of the "Me No Marijuana" hemp promoters would never have heard of hemp.

Third, very simply, hemp is not necessarily marijuana, but all marijuana is necessarily hemp. Swiss hemp has no THC limits, but Canadian and other Western European hemp have a very low limit.
See

Fourth, I find it very strange that "Industrial Hemp" advocates are opposed to people who support hemp cultivation, and tell the truth about it, and then suck up to people who want to arrest hemp farmers and lie about it.
See

Fifth, I will continue to run the NORML weekly press releases, as well as other stories about hemp, and I am delighted to have John Dvorak as the contributing editor of the Hemp Pages.

Sixth, anyone who thinks that the hemp issue can be separated from the rest of the cannabis issues is free to think that, but that is not my reading of the political reality.

Seventh, if at all possible, I will definitely avoid any future mention of CAIR. I wouldn’t want to create the impression that hemp causes bad manners.

For Mr. Clauder's views on how marijuana is to hemp as vodka is to potatoes see www.cair.net
-- RC)
